recording.note: Hand-written to look like real model output. Planted: AC 3 (no overlapping appointments) has only a negative case. AC 6 is vague in the story; TC-12 handles it correctly by not inventing a target.

cases.title: Book an available slot three days ahead
preconditions: Patient is signed in
The clinic calendar has Available slots in 3 days
steps: Select an Available slot in 3 days
cases.expected: The booking is confirmed, and the slot shows as greyed out for other patients.

ac_quotes.text: An appointment can be booked at least 2 hours and at most 60 days before the slot starts.
Only slots marked "Available" in the clinic calendar can be selected; booked slots are shown greyed out.

cases.title: Slot starting in exactly 2 hours can be booked
preconditions: Patient is signed in
An Available slot starts exactly 2 hours from now

ac_quotes.text: An appointment can be booked at least 2 hours and at most 60 days before the slot starts.

cases.title: Slot starting in 1 hour 59 minutes cannot be booked
preconditions: Patient is signed in
An Available slot starts 1 hour 59 minutes from now
cases.expected: The slot cannot be booked and no appointment is created.

ac_quotes.text: An appointment can be booked at least 2 hours and at most 60 days before the slot starts.

cases.title: Slot 60 days ahead can be booked
preconditions: Patient is signed in
An Available slot exists 60 days from today

ac_quotes.text: An appointment can be booked at least 2 hours and at most 60 days before the slot starts.

cases.title: Slot 61 days ahead cannot be booked
preconditions: Patient is signed in
cases.expected: No slot on that day can be booked.

ac_quotes.text: An appointment can be booked at least 2 hours and at most 60 days before the slot starts.

cases.title: Booked slot is greyed out and cannot be selected
preconditions: Patient is signed in
Another patient has booked tomorrow's first slot
steps: Open tomorrow in the clinic calendar
Try to select the booked slot
cases.expected: The slot is greyed out and nothing happens when it is selected.

ac_quotes.text: Only slots marked "Available" in the clinic calendar can be selected; booked slots are shown greyed out.

cases.title: Second booking that overlaps an existing appointment is rejected
preconditions: Patient is signed in
Patient has an appointment on the 14th from 10:00 to 10:30 at the Main Street clinic
steps: Select a slot on the 14th from 10:00 to 10:30 at the Park Road clinic
cases.expected: The booking is rejected with the message "You already have an appointment at this time".

ac_quotes.text: A patient cannot hold two appointments that overlap in time; the second booking is rejected with the message "You already have an appointment at this time".

cases.title: Cancel an appointment three days ahead
preconditions: Patient is signed in
Patient has an appointment in 3 days
cases.expected: The appointment is cancelled and no longer listed.

ac_quotes.text: A patient can cancel an appointment up to 24 hours before it starts; later cancellations are rejected with the message "Appointments can only be cancelled up to 24 hours in advance".

cases.title: Cancelling exactly 24 hours before the start is allowed
preconditions: Patient is signed in
Patient has an appointment that starts in exactly 24 hours

ac_quotes.text: A patient can cancel an appointment up to 24 hours before it starts; later cancellations are rejected with the message "Appointments can only be cancelled up to 24 hours in advance".

cases.title: Cancelling 23 hours before the start is rejected
preconditions: Patient is signed in
Patient has an appointment that starts in 23 hours
cases.expected: The cancellation is rejected with the message "Appointments can only be cancelled up to 24 hours in advance".

ac_quotes.text: A patient can cancel an appointment up to 24 hours before it starts; later cancellations are rejected with the message "Appointments can only be cancelled up to 24 hours in advance".

cases.title: Confirmation email has the date, time and clinic address
preconditions: Patient is signed in with email pat@example.com
steps: Open the confirmation email in pat@example.com
cases.expected: The email shows the appointment date, start time and the clinic's address.

ac_quotes.text: After booking, the patient receives a confirmation email with the date, time and clinic address.

cases.title: Calendar load time on a slow connection (target needed)
preconditions: Patient is signed in
Browser network throttling is set to the Slow 3G profile
steps: Record how long it takes until the slots are visible
cases.expected: The story gives no load-time target, so this case cannot pass or fail yet; record the observed time and ask the product owner to agree a target.

ac_quotes.text: The calendar should load quickly, even on slow connections.
